name: AI Strategy
description: How leaders connect AI to business strategy: where to start, what to prioritise, and how to move from scattered experiments to a coherent plan with real returns.

name: Governance & Responsible AI
description: Regulation, risk and accountability. The policies, tooling and training that let organisations adopt AI without losing control of it.

name: AI Agents
description: Systems of specialised agents that research, build and act. What they are good at today, how teams are architecting them, and what changes when software starts doing the work.

name: Enterprise Transformation
description: Field notes from deploying AI inside large organisations: scoping, scaling from proof-of-concept to production, and the people and data maturity that decides what succeeds.

name: Public Policy & Economics
description: AI in government and the wider economy. Machine learning for macroeconomic strategy, labour resilience, sovereignty and the European position in the AI race.

name: Healthcare & Pharma
description: AI in regulated, life-critical industries, where roadmaps span global markets and the gap between hype and genuine clinical or commercial value is widest.

name: E-Commerce
description: AI reshaping how online businesses understand customers, create content and close the gap between product language and what buyers are actually asking.
